## Evidence boundary

- [ ] Every observation links to declared public or synthetic evidence.
- [ ] Submitted and independently reproduced evidence are distinguished.
- [ ] The record includes prerequisites, limitations, non-transfer conditions, and a transfer test.
- [ ] Official-source dependencies have verification, review, and revalidation triggers.

## Public-release boundary

- [ ] `python federal-pilot-kit/aau_pilot.py validate lesson <path>` passes.
- [ ] `python federal-pilot-kit/aau_pilot.py scan-lesson <path>` reports zero findings.
- [ ] An authorized human completed redaction and publication review.
- [ ] No PII, credentials, classified, controlled, procurement-sensitive, source-selection, or vendor-confidential information is included.
- [ ] No vendor ranking, award recommendation, certification, official endorsement, or universal-practice claim is made.

## Verification

Paste the closeout and policy-dependency commands and their outputs. Do not paste protected source material.
